caption: What if every blue whale vanished forever? Blue whales are the largest animals known to have lived, up to about 33 m long, and one can eat around 16 tonnes of krill in a single day. You'd think losing them would mean a krill boom. But whale poop carries iron and nutrients back to the surface, where it feeds phytoplankton, the tiny ocean plants that help produce roughly half of the oxygen made on Earth. We wouldn't run out of air, but the ocean food web would get weaker. And this nearly happened: whaling killed about 360,000 blue whales in the first half of the 1900s. In heavily hunted Antarctic waters krill didn't boom, they fell by more than 80%. Blue whales have been protected since 1966, and their songs have even been recorded off Lakshadweep. Should YOU care about whale poop? 👇
